subject: SIG evidence request — organizational context, IAM screenshots, runbooks
messages:
From: Sam Cole <security@clearwaterbiotech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence request for Clearwater onboarding

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our vendor intake (SIG questionnaire), we need the supporting evidence for a handful of control families. Can you share a packet with the items below? If you can drop them in a shared Drive folder and reply here, that'd be ideal. Our target is to complete verification by May 14.

Priority items:
- Organizational chart and control owners (PDF)
- IAM console screenshots: user list, role bindings, SSO config (redacted is fine)
- Operational runbook for incident response and access revocation
- Data flow diagram showing how customer data traverses Redwood services
- Evidence of periodic access reviews and retention schedule

If anything will take longer than a week, please flag it and we can scope a partial deliverable.

Regards,
Sam Cole
Head of Security Operations
Clearwater Biotech
security@clearwaterbiotech.com

--
Attachment: request-checklist.csv (stub)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Cole <security@clearwaterbiotech.com>, Andrew Lee <andrew.lee@clearwaterbiotech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request for Clearwater onboarding

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear list. I've started a shared folder and uploaded the initial packet (link below). I'm looping in Neha (security/compliance) and Dylan (platform) to pull the IAM screenshots and data-flow diagram.

Shared folder (read-only link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Qx8kZ-clearwater-sig-packet
Contents uploaded now: org-security-runbook-v3.pdf, access-review-playbook.md
Planned uploads: iam-console-screenshots.zip (redacted), data-flow-diagram-v2.png

Question for you: when you say "access reviews" — do you need the raw reviewer notes, or a summary export showing reviewer, date, and action taken? We usually redact employee identifiers for external sharing.

I'll provide the IAM screenshots with redactions and a short README that documents what is redacted. Expect the rest by EOD Thu (May 6). If you need anything sooner, tell me which item is highest priority and we'll expedite.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance (Sales Ops liaison)
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0196

--
Attachments referenced: org-security-runbook-v3.pdf (stub), access-review-playbook.md (stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request for Clearwater onboarding

Priya — uploading the IAM artifacts now. Notes:
- iam-console-screenshots.zip contains exported screenshots from the AWS console and our identity provider (Okta). All accounts and user IDs are redacted; we include role ARN snapshots and the SSO app configuration page.
- access-review-playbook.md is our standard playbook describing quarterly reviews; it includes sample export columns (reviewer, date, decision).
- org-security-runbook-v3.pdf is in the folder and contains the incident escalation matrix and runbook steps (masked customer IDs).

Drive path: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Qx8kZ-clearwater-sig-packet (files under /IAM-and-runbooks/)
I've tagged the screenshots with timestamps and the console path in the README inside the zip. If Clearwater needs the raw CSV export for access reviews we will need to remove staff PII (can provide a redacted export).

Let me know if you want me to package a single zip for submission or keep the artifacts as separate files in the folder.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Compliance Manager
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: iam-console-screenshots.zip (stub)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — diagram upload

Priya / Neha — I uploaded the updated data-flow diagram (data-flow-diagram-v2.png) to the shared folder under /architecture/. The diagram highlights tokenization boundaries, where KV cache lives, and the customer-data ingress points. I annotated the PDF layer with brief notes about encryption-in-transit and at-rest.

If Clearwater wants a short walkthrough, I can record a 3–4 minute screencast showing the flow and the annotations. Also added a small README describing which components are deployed in-hosted vs. dedicated deployments.

Link to file: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1arch-dataflow-v2

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Platform Engineer
dylan_brooks@redwood.ai

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Cole <security@clearwaterbiotech.com>, Andrew Lee <andrew.lee@clearwaterbiotech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request for Clearwater onboarding — packet delivered

Hi Sam / Andrew — thanks for the patience. The requested SIG evidence packet is now in the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Qx8kZ-clearwater-sig-packet

What we uploaded:
- org-security-runbook-v3.pdf (incident response, escalation, contact matrix)
- iam-console-screenshots.zip (redacted: role ARNs, SSO config, permission boundaries)
- data-flow-diagram-v2.png (annotated, shows ingress/egress, caching)
- access-review-playbook.md (process and example export columns — reviewer / date / action)

Notes and clarifications:
- We redact internal employee identifiers by default; the IAM screenshots include role ARNs and SSO settings but not employee email addresses. If you need a CSV export of past reviews with reviewer names removed, we can provide a redacted export (will take one business day).
- The runbook contains live contact roles (title + rotation schedule) but omits personal phone numbers; we can provide escalation phone numbers under an NDA if required.
- For the retention schedule, see the 'Retention & retention_schedule' section inside org-security-runbook-v3.pdf. If you need a separate CSV or a signed attestation, let us know and I will escalate.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether this packet is sufficient for your SIG portal upload. If you require a short screencast walkthrough of the diagram or screenshots, Dylan can record and we will add it to the folder (or provide a private view link).

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
